name: sns_10mm_package_v0_screening

interpretation.claim_boundary: Screening calculation only; no path dimension or material is qualified hardware evidence.

limitations: All dimensions are explicit screening assumptions, not a released mechanical design.
One-dimensional kA/L paths omit contact resistance, spreading, temperature dependence, and internal radiation.
The 1.5 uncertainty multiplier is a declared placeholder pending tolerance and contact-resistance data.
The budget evaluates eclipse heat leakage only; illuminated-state rejection remains a separate constraint.
